notes.title: Next Fest Playtest Announcement!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45445304/498d5812bff5bea3547945c09cc313e47cb3db12.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Hi y'all! We're back with a [b]big announcement[/b] today! 🎉[/h3][p][/p][h2]Soul’s Remnant will be participating in Steam Next Fest with a new public playtest, starting on October 13th at 7 AM PDT![/h2][p][/p][h3]The playtest will have lots of new features we've been working on. It'll run for at least one week, and everyone’s welcome to join![/h3][p][/p][p]We’ll also be running private tests beforehand to make sure things work properly! 🛠️[/p][p]If you’re a [url="https://patreon.com/chaomoon"]Patreon supporter[/url], keep an eye out for testing access and exclusive early access to new features.[/p][p][/p][p]We know you've all been wanting to play Soul's Remnant again for a while now, so we hope you'll enjoy this upcoming public Next Fest playtest! 🤍[/p][p][/p][p]See you then, and if you're excited for the playtest, please be sure to join our [url="https://discord.gg/soulsremnant?event=1414435934283235378"]Next Fest Playtest event on Discord[/url]! 🤍[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/soulsremnant" style="button"]Join our Discord![/url][/p]

notes.title: What's next for Soul's Remnant (Playtest O Wrap-up!)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45445304/a27876b7ed4985dab3131c7bfc27eda0a7c0356b.png[/img]

As you likely already know, the first Steam playtest for Soul's Remnant concluded a couple weeks ago.

We are grateful to everyone who participated and hope you all enjoyed the game as much as we do.

Soul's Remnant is now in development mode, but expect another chance to play “soon.” We need time to squash bugs, fix glitches, and add new features.

[h3]In the meanwhile, check out these stats from Playtest O![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45445304/2fd6ee6fc95bd3db2f644c3997ec80b3b76822cc.png[/img]

[h3]If you participated in the recent playtest, tell us about your impressions with this [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSesLpF2sVGX8L9-yi1i2wy4FamoV520ig0ae4iBUT6Wi2yBhg/viewform?usp=sharing]quick feedback form[/url].[/h3]

Our community’s thoughts and opinions are very important to us as we move forward in development.
 
Also, if you’d like to support the game's development, [url=https://patreon.com/chaomoon]join our Patreon[/url]. We appreciate any support as we continue working on the game! ❤️

Besides that, follow us on [url=https://x.com/SoulsRemnant]Twitter[/url] and/or [url=https://bsky.app/profile/soulsremnant.com]Bluesky[/url], subscribe to [url=https://www.youtube.com/@chaomoon]our YouTube channel[/url], browse our [url=https://reddit.com/r/soulsremnant]Subreddit[/url], and [url=https://discord.gg/soulsremnant]join our Discord server[/url].

We will keep everyone updated on Soul’s Remnant’s progress with previews of new features through Discord and our social media. Thank you for being a part of our journey!

See you in-game again “soon!”

notes.title: Our first Steam playtest is now over, stay tuned for more~!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45445304/8dfad24d27950bfc74d5ca46794157c0d5d430a1.png[/img]

[h3]Thank you all for an amazing first playtest on Steam.[/h3]

I hope you all enjoyed the game, and the time you got to spend with it.
But don't worry, Soul's Remnant will be back!

[h3]The game will go back into development mode now, and emerge again in the future for another playtest![/h3]

If you enjoyed the game and want to help us in developing the game, please check out our [url=https://patreon.com/chaomoon]Patreon[/url]!

Please be sure to leave your feedback for the playtest in ⁠our [url=https://discord.gg/soulsremnant]Discord[/url] as well. We greatly appreciate community feedback, so be sure to leave any you may have, as it can help us improve the game!

And post your favorite screenshots from this playtest to [url=https://reddit.com/r/soulsremnant]our new subreddit[/url]! We'd love to see everyone share their favorite playtest moments and memories there~

And most importantly, stay tuned!
We'll keep you all up to date in our Discord and on social media with the newest Soul's Remnant previews!

Thank you so much for all your support.
We'll see you again soon! ❤️ ❤️

notes.title: Soul's Remnant Playtest O Extended!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45445304/c9e3d2f9a0dc034e2745ae9f75d788d9e1a91cf3.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

The playtest has been live for about a day and a half now, and we've been able to fix a whole lot of bugs and made a lot of optimizations to the server thanks to it!

We've seen how much fun you guys are having, so we've made a decision...

[h2][b]We're extending the current playtest by two days, until March 20th at 11 PM east coast time![/b][/h2]

We're hoping this provides people the time to experience the game more in a playable state, while it's still open for our playtest!

Thank you for playing Soul's Remnant and helping us improve the game!! ❤️ ❤️

[i](PS... we'll also be having some special events in game over the next few days, so stay tuned in game!!)[/i]

notes.title: Soul's Remnant Playtest O
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45445304/8d2fcfb6a3033aca88c8e49634ee53bd6e93831f.png[/img]

[h1]Soul's Remnant Playtest O Announcement![/h1]

Hi everyone! We've got a special announcement for you today!

We've been hard at work adding new features and content to Soul's Remnant lately!
To prepare for the game's eventual full release and test all these new features, we've decided to run a playtest for Soul's Remnant!
Explore the world of Soul's Remnant for yourself and make new friends in the world of Soul's Remnant during playtest O~!

[h2]The upcoming playtest will start on March 15th 2025, at 11 PM east coast time.[/h2]
[h3][url=https://discord.gg/soulsremnant]Join our Discord for more![/url][/h3]

The playtest will be open for 3 days, and will feature our newest content additions to the game, with the goal of us fixing bugs, balancing, and generally making the game better. Player feedback has also always been a crucial part of Soul's Remnant's development, so please be sure to report bugs and feedback on our Discord!

[b]If you're excited for Soul's Remnant Playtest O[/b], be sure to [url=https://discord.gg/soulsremnant]join our Discord server[/url] to stay up to date on playtesting  and development news, see previews of new content, and chat with our amazing community!


[i]EDIT: This post has been edited as we've decided not to launch our open beta for now, and instead we'll run a smaller 3 day long playtest named "Playtest O" while we focus on developing and adding content to Soul's Remnant the best we can. Thank you for your understanding! <3[/i]
